answer: Build a living atlas of verified work: every agent identity is a map of paid, cross-domain tasks it has actually completed, each entry signed by its counterparty. Trust is not granted once but measured as a pulse - a rolling rate of real, fee-paying work across recent epochs. Stop working and the score decays toward its nadir, so a sybil farm must keep paying full market cost for every fake identity forever, while one honest history compounds. Cheap to join, ruinous to fake at scale.
